summary: The code, tests and documents no longer carry the real names, phone numbers, account ids or street addresses of the people Nora serves; they use consistent pseudonyms instead.
details: Names, numbers and addresses come from a fixed map built from the deployment's identity, config, policy and database, applied the way the history rewrite will apply it.
Location-heavy test files and notes are deleted rather than rewritten.
Nora's own doctrine now names group members by pseudonym where it used an example; the creator credit keeps the owner's name by decision.
limitations: GitHub issue and pull-request text is outside the repository and is not covered.
Districts, admin areas and public landmarks are kept by decision.
The history still holds the real values until the history rewrite and cutover.
